title: Introduce staged metadata curator and vernacular release summaries
author: Elena Park
description: Purpose: add a lightweight staged metadata curator that writes incremental, epoched metadata snapshots and a small generation utility that produces concise human-friendly release summaries (vernacular release summaries) from snapshot deltas. Motivation: customers asked for clearer, high-level release blurbs and safer metadata roll-forward that can be inspected and rolled back by SRE/product during rollouts. This change introduces: 1) a SnapshotStore abstraction (pluggable backends) and an 'epoch' writer that atomically commits small metadata deltas; 2) a deterministic delta serializer that keeps metadata compact and preserves provenance hashes; 3) a rollback playbook and CLI hook (scripts/curator/rollback) that runs pre-validated reversions; 4) a Verbalizer service (registry/verbalizer) that converts structured delta summaries into short, audience-targeted release summaries and recommended migration notes; 5) schema/compat checks and a new staged-curation workflow orchestrator that gates snapshots behind automated validations and sampled CI smoke tests; 6) short docs and templates under docs/releases/vernacular_templates.md and an end-to-end CI job on model-registry-release that runs the snapshotter against a canned sample. Backwards compatibility: SnapshotStore default uses existing metadata bucket layout; no migration of current model records required. Operational notes: snapshots are TTL'd (30d default) and compacted weekly; verbose release text generation runs as an optional job (opt-in per namespace). Rollout plan: feature flagged off-by-default, staged on internal staging then all account sandboxes, then opt-in customers. Related: ENG-1284 (curation UX), ENG-1299 (release brief automation). Checklist: - [x] Snapshot writer implementation - [x] Verbalizer generator for release briefs - [x] CLI rollback hook and playbook - [x] Unit tests for serializer and store - [x] Documentation and example invocation - [x] Add CI job for snapshot smoke test
commits: 4 commits: 1) Add SnapshotStore interface and file-backed implementation (author: Elena Park) 2) Add delta serializer, provenance hash and unit tests (author: Elena Park) 3) Add Verbalizer service and templates + docs (author: Elena Park) 4) Add rollback CLI, CI job and wiring for feature flag (author: Elena Park). Full commit messages available in branch history.
review_thread: Noah Kim: Can we guarantee idempotency if two controllers attempt epoch-commit concurrently? Elena Park: epoch_writer uses optimistic compare-and-swap on the provenance hash and falls back to a retry loop with exponential backoff; added unit tests to simulate concurrent writes. Priya Desai: The verbalizer templates look long — can we ensure they are short enough for product summaries? Elena Park: templates produce three length tiers (short, medium, long) and team docs specify short as default for release briefs. Jonah Li: Add a note on retention and cost of snapshot storage. Elena Park: default TTL is 30d and compaction job is weekly; added cost estimate to docs. Priya Desai: CI flakes on one test during first run (test_delta_serializer::test_roundtrip), fixed by tightening timestamp normalization. Noah Kim: Approving after the test fix and a small doc tweak. Merge performed with squash-merge.

release_notes: Added a staged metadata snapshot system (SnapshotStore + epoched deltas) and a release verbalizer that auto-generates concise, audience-targeted release summaries from metadata deltas. Defaults are opt-in behind a feature flag; includes a rollback CLI and CI smoke test. Impact: enables safer metadata rollouts and readable release briefs for product/security teams.
